title: About
content:
About

Pagefeather is an open-source framework for WordPress and WooCommerce on Cloudflare.

Two paths ship today. b-dosql keeps PHP and SQLite in one Durable Object. Approach A runs PHP in a Worker and reaches MySQL through Hyperdrive.

Product stance

  • No hosted Pagefeather product. You run everything in your own Cloudflare account.
  • No funnel and no upsell.
  • Friendly never means selling. Limits sit next to capabilities.
  • Do not make a test pass by softening the test. Fix the engine or the install. You may exclude a case; write the reason and the issue next to the exclusion.
  • A result is measured only after a real deploy and a test.

Project

  • License: GPL-2.0.
  • Maintainer: Skyphusion Labs.
  • Before 2026-11-13 the repository name was wordpress-on-cloudflare.
  • The project is young. Some parts are measured and solid. Some are still being built.

Contribute

Source, issues, and docs live at github.com/skyphusion-labs/pagefeather. Start with the README, then the guide index under docs/guide/.
